name: Pole
editorial_article:
Pole is the primary artistic alias of Stefan Betke, a German electronic musician, producer, and mastering engineer born in 1967. Originally from Düsseldorf, Betke became a central figure in the development of the glitch genre, characterized by his innovative use of damaged, crackling, and looped audio artifacts. He gained significant acclaim for his seminal trilogy of albums—titled simply 1, 2, and 3—which he began in Cologne and completed after relocating to Berlin. His work is often described as dubtronic, blending the rhythmic sensibilities of dub music with the experimental textures of digital glitch aesthetics.

Beyond his output as a recording artist, Betke is an influential figure in the Berlin electronic scene through his technical contributions as a mastering engineer and his work as a label head. He founded the label ~scape, which became a cornerstone for experimental electronic music, and later established his own self-titled label, Pole, in 2011 to manage his back-catalog and new releases. His production style, defined by the deliberate manipulation of digital errors, has left a lasting impact on the landscape of contemporary electronic music.
editorial_bio: Pole is the alias of German electronic musician Stefan Betke, a pioneer of the glitch and dubtronic genres known for his influential trilogy of albums.
